encoding: MCE v2 mandate, Candidate V3, EIP-712 {Mandate, 1, chainId, gate} (docs/execution-gate.md)
note: Integers are decimal strings. The Solidity harness replays the ABI form of these same entries, written by the same generator run to contracts/generated/gate-v1.abi.json (not committed). Tokens are labelled fixtures and the adapter is ScriptedAdapter: this corpus exercises the gate decision, not a venue.

vectors.description: BUY 10 fAAPL within a 2010 USD MAX_TOTAL_DEBIT; the adapter refunds unspent funding.
SELL 10 fAAPL for at least 1990 USD MIN_TOTAL_CREDIT.
fundingLimit exactly equal to the converted MAX_TOTAL_DEBIT, fully spent.
Credit exactly equal to fundingLimit, itself exactly the converted MIN_TOTAL_CREDIT.
Debit exactly equal to fundingLimit and credit exactly equal to quantity.
A mandate bound in 2-decimal USD, converted exactly to 6-decimal funding atoms.
An 8-decimal representation paid for with an 18-decimal funding token.
Synthetic exposure explicitly permitted by the mandate.
The adapter over-delivers: more output is never a violation.
The adapter returns garbage claiming an enormous fill; the gate reads nothing it returns.
Non-empty route data, committed by the agent.
block.timestamp == expiresAt - 1, deadline extended to it: live.
block.timestamp == expiresAt: expired (exclusive, as the kernel).
A deadline past the mandate expiry does not extend the mandate.
Executed on a chain other than the deployment chain.

Principal signature made for a different gate address.
Principal signature made for the same gate address on another chain.
High-s twin of a valid principal signature.
Execution signed by someone other than the mandate agent.

Token substituted after the agent signed.

Recipient substituted after the agent signed.

Quantity in SHARE rather than TOKEN: a share is not a token under a multiplier.
Quantity at 6 decimals for an 18-decimal token.
Mandate economic limit in EUR for a USD-settled market.
Agent-signed recipient other than the principal.
fundingLimit one atom above the converted MAX_TOTAL_DEBIT.
Sub-atom bound rounds down: 2010.0000009 USD permits only 2010.000000 USDC.
SELL fundingLimit one atom below the converted MIN_TOTAL_CREDIT.
Sub-atom minimum rounds up: 1989.9999991 USD requires 1990.000000 USDC.
A MIN_TOTAL_CREDIT too large for uint256 in funding atoms: unreachable, refused.
A MAX_TOTAL_DEBIT too large for uint256 saturates: any representable limit is within it.
The adapter delivers one atom less than the quantity.
The adapter delivers the full quantity to someone else.
SELL proceeds one atom below the agent-signed minimum.
The adapter pulls extra funding through an allowance the principal granted it directly.
The principal allowance to the gate is one atom short.
The principal balance is one atom short.
An exact per-mandate allowance, consumed exactly.
The funding token's decimals changed after the gate pinned them.
The representation's decimals changed after the gate pinned them.
The identical attempt twice: the second is refused.
A second, differently-signed execution of a consumed mandate is refused.
An attempt whose venue reverts consumes nothing; the retry settles.
An attempt refused at settlement consumes nothing; the retry settles, then a replay is refused.
Two mandates differing only in nonce are independently spendable.
Retried after expiry: time never restores or extends an authorization.
Allowlist in non-canonical order, signed as given.
Identifier with a character outside the kernel charset.
